run_time_func_benchmark: run time_func to benchmark a function over 100 iterations and print average ms
test_time_func_with_custom_iterations: test time_func by passing a custom number of iterations for benchmarking
test_time_func_with_named_function: test time_func by providing a custom name label for the benchmark output
review_time_func_warmup: review time_func to understand its 5-iteration warmup phase before timing
summarize_time_func: summarize time_func which measures average execution time in milliseconds using perf_counter
